projects.title: Project 1: Video analysis
projects.instructions: Choose one pair of clips from the same sport. Analysis 1 uses clip 1, Analysis 2 uses clip 2, and Analysis 3 compares both side by side. Use text and a variety of drawing tools.

analyses.title: Analysis 1
analyses.instructions: One example of each. You must draw to show mastery.

prompts.title: Friction
prompts.detail: When, where, what. Is it a good thing or a bad thing for the athlete?

prompts.title: Gravity
prompts.detail: When, where, what. How does this affect performance in this moment?

prompts.title: Stretch-shortening cycle
prompts.detail: What is stretching and shortening, when and where. Why do they do it?

analyses.title: Analysis 2
analyses.instructions: Two examples of each. You must draw to show mastery.

prompts.title: Muscles
prompts.detail: Motion or action, then the agonist and antagonist. Use anatomical (Latin) names.

prompts.title: Joints
prompts.detail: Location, then the type of joint or its classification. Plain language is fine.

prompts.title: Planes and axes
prompts.detail: Motion or action, then the plane it happens in and the axis it rotates about.

analyses.title: Analysis 3
analyses.instructions: Put the two clips side by side and lock them together at the first critical movement. Then write over the playing videos (text required, drawing optional).

prompts.title: Side by side and synced
prompts.detail: Both clips side by side, locked together from the start.

prompts.title: Relevant observation
prompts.detail: Something from class not yet covered in this project. Ideas: rigid body mechanics, length, weight, mass, inertia, levers, concentric, eccentric and isometric actions, kinetic chain checkpoints, open and closed kinetic chains, paths of motion.
